description:
Thanks Art W For sponsoring this event!  They create beautiful works of art, and they would like to help you paint the army or miniature of your dreams. https://www.artwstudio.com/

===============GAME INFO=============

4 Players enter, one player leaves.  4 generals create a 600 point list for our Warhammer 40k King of the Colosseum 40k Variant and compete to see who will take home the crown.  The twist?  You will randomly draw which army you get to play. So all the players will need bring out their A game if they hope to succeed. 

===============ARMY LIST=============
Army Lists incoming

Orks
Thousand Sons
Tyranids
Astra Militarum
